besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two main clauses (''n Hartoorplanting duur' / 'die pasiënt moet').
besluite.rede: Both clauses have their own subject and verb, so the AWS 2017 comma is required and nothing else changes.

besluite.fout: 'die infeksie' points back to an infection the text has not named.
besluite.rede: The general noun reads naturally and the claim (germs in a wound cause infection) is unchanged.

besluite.fout: ''n Oop bors laat ... kieme by die wond kom' is wooden.
besluite.rede: The time clause says the same thing naturally, and the permissive 'laat' already meant 'kan'.
The extraposed relative clause is ordinary Afrikaans and the original image of the heart beating inside a dying body reads well; the proposal is a lateral move that drops 'in'.

besluite.fout: 'gevind dat' copies English 'found that' and in Afrikaans can read as 'were of the opinion that'.
besluite.rede: 'ontdek dat' is the natural verb for a discovery and fits the lesson's 'ontdekkings' without moving the meaning.

besluite.fout: Two verbs of different clauses ('inloop' and 'moet') meet without a comma.
besluite.rede: The comma between the clause verbs follows AWS practice and makes the sentence easier to read.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two main clauses, and 'bloed kon later' is a stiff order.
besluite.rede: The comma is required and fronting 'later' is the natural Afrikaans order, with the same facts in the same sequence.

besluite.fout: ''n prent' is vague where the X-ray picture just described is meant.
besluite.rede: 'so 'n prent' ties the sentence to the X-ray picture without adding or changing anything.

besluite.fout: 'van 'n ander mens se liggaam' is slightly roundabout in a glossary definition.
besluite.rede: This rewords a [begrip] definition beyond a spelling or grammar fix, so only the writer may change it, across every lesson that uses it.
